description: Zamowa, a living whispered charm of old Slavic spells, a floating pale old mask-like face with closed eyes and whispering lips, made of woven glowing white-gold threads of light, long trailing ribbons of light covered with glowing rune signs, two thin hands of light raised to cast a spell, an abstract magical creature, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, eerie and menacing, floating, full body, three-quarter view, the creature alone, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
